environment.data: Isolated local Firebase Auth and Firestore emulators with a synthetic account and no selected child

emulatorHttpAndWorker: Exchanged an emulator-issued identity token for a production-route session and acknowledged the account terms.
Created a directory source, replayed the same operation, listed the card and saved a same-origin form login through its independent credential endpoint.
Claimed the due card using the Firestore worker service, retrieved the original form credential for its current lease and completed the check with a controlled MFA-required result.
The HTTP card read showed mfa_required and no next check. After removal, direct read returned 404 and the card disappeared from the account list.
edge: An authenticated account with no children opened the memory page and added a single document via the visible controls. The frequency defaulted to 10080 minutes.

Opened the new card, navigated to its direct authorization link and filled the website account, masked password and same-origin login page. The authenticated API returned an opaque credential reference.
Removed the isolated synthetic card and closed the browser context and emulator.
initialFailuresAndCorrections: The Windows sandbox could not reach its local Firebase emulator hub. The same isolated no-model check passed using approved local loopback execution.
The first Edge pass could not locate the name field by its accessible name. Explicit accessible labels on the new form fields fixed this, and the complete browser workflow passed.

After adding refresh-on-return, one hook test invoked submit while the control was still disabled. It now waits for the return read and verifies the control becomes enabled before exercising the unknown result.
boundaries: The scheduled external acquisition adapter, private ingestion and formal assistant tools are integrated by the coordinating work packages.

MFA, payment and CAPTCHA results were tested as worker outcomes. No third-party paid login, real account secrets, live model, cloud index change, Android device or production deployment was exercised.
